Questions

Frequently asked

Per person or per car?

Per car with driver. One or four passengers — same price. 5–8 people travel in two cars.

What if my flight is delayed?

We track your flight and adjust. No delay surcharge.

Is there a night rate?

No. Airport is 7,500 RSD at any hour.

How does waiting work?

Return trips (Belgrade, IKEA, Outlet) include up to 2 hours free waiting, Bosnia up to 3 hours.

How can I pay?

Online (Apple Pay, Google Pay, card), IPS QR, cash to the driver in RSD or EUR, or invoice.

Can I cancel?

Yes, free up to 24 hours before, under “My ride”.

Montenegro and the EU?

Yes. Montenegro from €400 one way, EU on request.

Flying tomorrow?
